articles.title: Margaret Hamilton, whose software helped land Apollo 11 on the Moon, dies at 90
articles.description: Pioneering computer scientist led the development of the software for Nasa's Apollo mission and was awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom.

articles.title: Three people killed in Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia airports, officials say
articles.description: The Houthis have claimed responsibility for the attacks, which mark an escalation in the conflict.

articles.title: Israelis demand accountability over 7 October failures three years after attacks
articles.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has refused to take any personal responsibility for what happened or order a state inquiry.

articles.title: Man to face trial for attempted murder of British girl in Alps knife attack
articles.description: A man who allegedly stabbed a British toddler at a playground in the French Alps will go on trial charged with attempted murder, prosecutors have said.
